title: Evaluating the risk of ovarian cancer before surgery using the ADNEX model to differentiate between benign, borderline, early and advanced stage invasive, and secondary metastatic tumors: prospective multicentre diagnostic study
evidence_level: Tier-1 Validated Multiclass Clinical Prediction Model (N=5,914 patients across 24 clinical centers)

clinical_predictors.name: ca125_level
clinical_predictors.description: Serum CA-125 level (Optional: ADNEX model can operate with or without CA-125).

clinical_predictors.name: center_type
clinical_predictors.description: Type of center: Oncology Referral Center (tertiary) vs Secondary Community Hospital.

ultrasound_predictors.name: max_lesion_diameter_mm
ultrasound_predictors.description: Maximum diameter of the whole adnexal mass in 3 orthogonal planes.

ultrasound_predictors.name: max_solid_component_diameter_mm
ultrasound_predictors.description: Maximum diameter of the largest solid component in mm. If no solid component, value is 0.

ultrasound_predictors.name: more_than_10_locules
ultrasound_predictors.description: Presence of more than 10 cystic locules separated by complete septa.

ultrasound_predictors.name: acoustic_shadows
ultrasound_predictors.description: Presence of acoustic shadowing behind the lesion (characteristic of benign teratomas, fibromas).

ultrasound_predictors.name: ascites
ultrasound_predictors.description: Presence of peritoneal fluid extending outside the pouch of Douglas.

predicted_subgroups: Stage I primary invasive ovarian carcinoma
Stage II-IV primary invasive ovarian carcinoma
